openSource.name: db2toon
openSource.description: A Go CLI that turns existing database schemas into compact, human-readable TOON context for developers and AI coding agents. It supports MCP and multiple database engines, helping reduce schema-context overhead compared with raw SQL or verbose interchange formats.

openSource.name: Clean Fullstack Go + Vite + React
openSource.description: A production-oriented full-stack boilerplate that embeds a Vite + React frontend into a Go binary while keeping frontend and backend boundaries explicit. Designed to ship as one binary early, then detach into API + CDN deployment later without rewriting the product architecture.

openSource.name: Go PSTE Modular Monolith
openSource.description: An open-source Go architecture built around Plug, Swap, Toggle, Extract: swap infrastructure implementations without touching business logic, toggle features through configuration, and keep domain modules extractable when microservices are actually justified.

openSource.name: bev-fs
openSource.description: A Bun + Elysia + Vue full-stack framework built around deployment freedom and end-to-end TypeScript safety, with directory-based API/page routing, automatic route discovery, middleware composition, scaffolding templates, and single-port production deployment.

openSource.name: MacaUang · Camera Money Detector
openSource.description: A Flutter mobile app that combines the device camera, Claude 3.5 Haiku vision-language capabilities, and text-to-speech to identify banknotes and announce denominations—designed to support visually impaired users.

openSource.name: NextJS Fullstack Monolith
openSource.description: An MVP-oriented monolith for small teams and solo engineers with explicit server/client/shared boundaries, a Handler → Service → Repository backend, service-owned transactions, shared API contracts and RBAC, JWT auth, and S3-compatible file uploads.

openSource.name: Natural language → query
openSource.description: A Go library for translating plain-language requests into SQL or NoSQL queries using embeddings and LLM-assisted generation—part of a broader focus on LLM APIs, structured context, and AI-powered developer tooling.

openSource.name: JKT48 NLP Bot
openSource.description: A Python/Tweepy social-media analysis bot that automated NLP tasks around public JKT48 content, including sentiment analysis, emotion analysis, and word-cloud generation.

privateNote: More public experiments include PostgreSQL tooling, KNN-from-scratch work in Go, Flutter prototypes, and a Telegram-to-Discord live notification bridge. The GitHub profile has the full public history.
